mode: Built-in image_gen; no external API key or paid media library.
workflow: Generate six-pose 3×2 sprite sheets; inspect; mechanically crop and assemble ping-pong GIFs with Pillow. No optical-flow interpolation or invented in-between poses.

prompts.initial:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: precisely gridded 6-keyframe sprite sheet to assemble a real looping exercise demonstration GIF.
Primary request: a SINGLE wide 3-column by 2-row grid of EXACTLY SIX equally sized square frames, edge-to-edge no gutters no borders no labels, 1536 x 1024 pixels. Read order left to right top to bottom is six successive stages of ONE incline dumbbell bench press concentric phase from lowered weights to raised weights.
Style: clean elegant high-end 3D instructional illustration, anatomically plausible athletic adult male training mannequin with neutral medium gray skin, plain charcoal shorts, no text, no logos. Same full body, same dumbbells, same bench in every cell. Background uniform warm ivory #f5f4ef. Very subtle floor shadow. Everything fits within every cell with generous equal margins.
Camera: identical fixed three-quarter side view for all six frames; face to the upper right. Show BOTH arms and both separate dumbbells. Adjustable bench with backrest inclined exactly45 degrees, head/back/butt supported, feet planted firmly on floor, knees flexed. Bench is oriented diagonally left-to-right and NEVER moves.
Biomechanical invariants: shoulder blades retracted and torso stable; wrists straight above elbows; palms face forward with identical pronated grip. Upper arms about45degrees from torso at lowered position. The ONLY changes across six frames are shoulder and elbow joint angles plus the two handheld dumbbells moving along the natural pressing path. Keep bones lengths, size, identity, camera and all equipment perfectly consistent.
Frame1 top-left: weights beside upper chest, elbows bent about90degrees, forearms near vertical.
Frame2 top-middle: both weights pressed upward20percent.
Frame3 top-right: both weights pressed upward40percent.
Frame4 bottom-left: both weights pressed upward60percent.
Frame5 bottom-middle: both weights pressed upward80percent.
Frame6 bottom-right: arms nearly straight with both dumbbells above upper chest, wrists over shoulders, dumbbells separate, no elbow hyperextension.
This is an exercise demonstration not collage. Do not duplicate the same static pose in six cells. No motion arrows, no anatomy labels, no highlighted muscles, no extra limbs, no background gym, no decorative graphics.
prompts.revision: Edit the supplied six-panel incline dumbbell press sprite sheet. Preserve the identical character, background, 3x2 square-cell grid, camera, bench, planted feet, lighting, framing. Correct ONLY the arm/dumbbell movement sequence. Six poses must be continuous left-to-right top-to-bottom and must NOT restart in the bottom row. Frame1 elbows90degrees flexed weights besideupperchest; frame2 elbows75degrees; frame3 elbows60degrees; frame4 elbows45degrees; frame5 elbows25degrees; frame6 BOTH ARMS FULLY EXTENDED with only5degrees of elbow flexion, dumbbells highabove the upperchest aligned over shoulders. Final panel must show straight arms, not another bent-elbow pose. Shoulderblades stay anchored, torso absolutely stationary, two dumbbells at identical heights in every frame. Reproduce unchanged grid composition. No addedtext orlabels.
